designs.title: Pisa
designs.why: Clean, pretty stamp that I'd actually wear: crisp perforated edge, nice serif PISA, detailed tower that reads instantly from across the room, and it looks great on both white and black. The '3.97 degrees' value with the stamp tilted and the tower standing straight is a cute wink once you get it. But most people won't notice it, so at a glance it's just a nice souvenir-shop stamp, which feels a bit plain for $50. Up close the little tufts along the ground look like random marks, and the tower's flat base sits awkwardly on the sloped road.
designs.fix: Make the joke obvious at a glance: lean the stamp more, or set the ground level so the upright tower clearly 'corrects' the tilt, and swap the unreadable ground tufts for a cleaner baseline or tiny recognizable tourists pushing the tower.
